## Checklist

- [ ] My PR is linked to an open issue
- [ ] I made my changes on a branch other than `main`
- [ ] I tested the change locally
- [ ] `dotnet build` succeeds
- [ ] `dotnet test` succeeds
- [ ] My change is focused on the linked issue
- [ ] I did not modify CI/CD configuration unless the issue requires it
